items.text: Shoko raJehovha rakasvika kuna Zefania, mwanakomana waKushi, mwanakomana waGedharia, mwanakomana waAmaria, mwanakomana waHezekia, pamazuva okutonga kwaJosia mwanakomana waAmoni mambo weJudha richiti:
Ndichatambanudza ruoko rwangu kuti ndirwise Judha
Ndichaparadza kubva panzvimbo ino vose vakasara vaBhaari,
uye vasingatsvaki Jehovha kana kubvunza kwaari.
zuva rerima nokusuwa, zuva ramakore nezarima.
Zuva rehwamanda nemhere yehondo yokurwisa maguta akakomberedzwa namasvingo, nokurwisa shongwe dzomumakona.

items.text: Unganai pamwe chete, unganai pamwe chete,
uye zuva iroro risati rapfuura sehundi,
kutsamwa kukuru kwaJehovha kusati kwauya pamusoro penyu,
zuva rehasha dzaJehovha risati rauya pamusoro penyu.
Tsvakai Jehovha, imi mose vanyoro vapanyika,
Pamasikati makuru Ashidhodhi richasiyiwa risisina chinhu
Mune nhamo imi munogara pedyo negungwa,
Nyika iri pedyo negungwa, panogara vaKereti,
ndizvo zvinotaura Wamasimba Ose, Mwari waIsraeri,
vachararama vorudzi rwangu vachagara nhaka yenyika yavo."
Izvi ndizvo zvavachawana nokuda kwokuzvikudza kwavo,
nokuti vakatuka uye vakadadira vanhu vaJehovha Wamasimba Ose.
Achatambanudza ruoko rwake kuti arwise nyika
Mapoka amakwai nemombe zvichavata pasi imomo,

items.text: Mangwanani oga oga anotonga nokururamisira kwake,
kana kuranga kwangu kwose hakungauyi pariri.
kuti vose zvavo vadane kuzita raJehovha
Kubva mhiri kwenzizi dzeEtiopia vanamati vangu,
muguta rino vaya vanofara mukuzvikudza kwavo.
hauzotyizve kuti ungakuvadzwa nechinhu chipi zvacho.
